records.label: pipeline above 1024 tokens
records.hypothesis: The batch-1 prefill bulk path serializes ~11.17 ms CPU gather and ~3.50 ms H2D before layers. Route medium prefill to existing bounded pipeline to overlap this work; preserve bulk for decode.
records.expected_bottleneck: unoverlapped CPU gather and H2D at batch1 length2048
records.change: Lower default auto-policy bulk cutoff from 4096 to 1024 tokens; no arithmetic/table/precision changes.
records.decision: Accepted: primary b1 prefill offload latency and absolute gap repeatably reduced; exactness, full matrix, generation and memory gates passed under predeclared uncertainty criteria.
records.confirmation_run_outcome: R02 benchmark_failed: nonalternating paired design; preserved
limitations: Three independent blocks give wide intervals for small effects. No decode, b8 prefill or generation gain claim.
b16 prefill offload is slower in all three audit pairs (mean 3.393 ms, reduction CI [-9.406,2.619]); unresolved under the declared criterion, preserved as a limitation.
GPU operator profiler unavailable; separate CUDA events cover transfers, CPU traces cover gather and coordination.
Seeded random weights establish equivalence/performance, not language quality.

records.label: serial byte copies for tiny CPU lookups
records.hypothesis: Avoid torch CPU dispatch/thread-pool overhead for bulk gathers of <=8 tokens using serial byte copies into the existing pinned buffer. Baseline model profiles show 24/44 us CPU gather at b1/b8 decode; CPU microdiagnostic shows 4.68->2.70 us and 24.56->17.21 us for hot lookups. Confirm end-to-end effects independently.
records.expected_bottleneck: tiny bulk CPU table gather and associated CPU scheduling overhead
records.change: Precreate zero-copy uint8 NumPy views; copy each requested row for <=8 tokens when CPU table is contiguous. Fall back to torch index_select for other inputs. No value/lookup caching, dtype conversion, global thread changes or extra table storage.

screen.reason_no_batch16: Only CPU lookup implementation for <=8 tokens changes; transfer volume and pipeline scheduling remain fixed.

records.label: two-layer groups in automatic pipeline
records.hypothesis: Amortize pipeline producer/event/copy coordination across two adjacent layers. A0001 b1 prefill uses 24 group submissions; baseline b8 profile records 24 acquisitions with 92.8 ms summed CPU wait and 24 copy submissions. Halving group count may reduce scheduling overhead, at the cost of larger first transfer and doubled slot capacity.
records.expected_bottleneck: per-group CPU producer and H2D coordination
records.change: Automatic pipeline uses minimum group size 2; explicit pipeline policy preserves requested group size. Bulk decode unchanged. Add configurable automatic minimum, default 2. No arithmetic change.

records.label: caller-thread pipeline producer
records.hypothesis: Prepare each one-layer group on the calling CPU thread before its consumer, retaining copy-stream overlap with previously queued GPU work. Avoid worker dispatch, separate thread CUDA context and main/producer handshakes. A0001 b1 profile spends 10.55 ms summed CPU ticket acquisition; b8 baseline 92.8 ms. These overlaps are not additive, so measure end-to-end.
records.expected_bottleneck: producer/main-thread coordination and CPU scheduling
records.change: Replace background producer submission with per-group inline production, keeping identical gather, copy stream, buffer slots, events, group size and arithmetic. No A0002 byte-copy or A0003 grouping changes.

records.label: compute-stream copies for tiny bulk transfers
records.hypothesis: For <=8 tokens, place the tiny H2D directly on the consuming compute stream and skip the redundant first-layer cross-stream wait. Baseline decode profiles show ~5.5/5.8 us CPU H2D submission and ~11/22 us transfer spans at b1/b8. Reduced stream coordination may exceed the lost Q/K overlap for such small transfers.

records.change: Use compute-stream H2D only for <=8 token bulk calls, preserving copied/consumed events for pinned-host and cross-call buffer safety. Keep separate-copy-stream path for larger bulk calls and pipeline unchanged. Fresh torch gather every call; no A0002/A0003/A0004 changes.
